__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’
__broaden__.αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., intensive with σφίσι: ’for themselves’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: αὐτοῖς ὀβελοῖσιν ’the very spits’
__broaden__.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
__broaden__.αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’ · also object of τίουσι, neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’the proper deeds’ (αἴσιμα ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων)
__broaden__.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’ · also continuing a wish after εἴ πως, with a new subject: ’and might (she) grant’ (δοίη δέ μοι εὖχος Ἀθήνη ’and might Athena grant me glory’) · also in a main-clause wish: ’may (Zeus) give’ (Ζεύς τοι δοίη ’may Zeus give you’)
__broaden__.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’gives, is to give’ (οἵ τ’ … βῶσιν καί σφι Ζεὺς … δώῃ)
__broaden__.ἀέξῃ: ἀέξω — make grow, rear, increase; pres. subj. 3 sg. (after αἴ κεν) · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause (ὅς … κάμῃσι, θεὸς … ἀέξῃ): ’may make grow’
__broaden__.οἴω: οἶος — alone; masc. nom. dual: ’we two alone’ · also ὀΐω (οἴομαι) — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg., epic (= Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’ (οὐδὲ δύ’ οἴω ’nor two, I think’)
__broaden__.ἐστόρεσεν: στόρνυμι — spread, spread smooth; aor. 3 sg.: ’spread smooth, calmed’ (of the sea) · also ’spread (a hide) as bedding’ (ἐπὶ δέρμα … ἐστόρεσεν)
__broaden__.ἔλυσε: λύω — loose, undo, untie; aor. 3 sg.; with ἀπό in tmesis (ἀπὸ … ἔλυσε = ἀπέλυσε) ’loosed off’ · also with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἔλυσε = ὑπέλυσε) ’loosed beneath’, of the knees
__broaden__.ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι) · also causal + indic.: ’since, because’ (ὅτ’ οὐκ ἐθέλουσι δικαίως ’since they are not willing to act justly’)
__broaden__.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
__broaden__.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀλόχῳ (ᾗ … ἀλόχῳ ’his own wife’) · also relative adverb of place, ’where, by which way’ (ᾗ οἱ Ἀθήνη πέφραδε ’where Athena had pointed out to him’)
__broaden__.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
__broaden__.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg.
